documents.title: Orders API Notes
documents.content: POST /api/orders creates an order and requires customer_id, sku, quantity, and payment_token. GET /api/orders/{id} returns order status, submitted_at, and fulfillment_state. Invalid payment_token returns HTTP 402 with error code PAYMENT_REQUIRED.
